notes: Overview: Verdigris runs telemetry ingestion + realtime alerting and operator chat. High TPS for embeddings + low-latency chat for operators.
Primary ask: Dedicated GPU pool across 3 regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west) with deterministic throughput SLAs and explicit failover headroom.

POC summary: 10k qps embedding feign tests, chat p95 targets hit at 95ms when local, but cross-region failover increased p95 to ~280ms under burst -> need better routing + reserved cross-region capacity.

Reserved GPU planning (draft): baseline 24 x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs distributed as 10 / 8 / 6 across regions, plus 20% failover headroom (additional 5 GPUs reserved on standby across regions) for capacity guarantees.
Burst strategy requested: 30% burst allowance for short windows (1-5 min). Customer wants explicit billing/credit model for burst beyond reserved baseline.
Latency SLOs: p95 chat <= 120ms (regional), p95 reranking <= 150ms, embedding throughput >= 8K vectors/sec aggregate. Must be measured at edge (customer-app-facing).

Throughput guarantees: Sustained token/sec budget per region with documented max-concurrency and queueing expectations; want SLA credits if sustained throughput below 90% of committed capacity for more than 10 minutes.

Routing/fallback: customer requires smart routing by latency + cost, automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized model when primary saturated. Must preserve semantic parity for reranking within 5% quality loss.
Security/compliance: VPC peering and private endpoints required; SOC2 evidence mandatory; KMS integration for model & request encryption; data residency for EU subset (eu-west region).

Operational expectations: 24/7 on-call during cutover & major upgrades; maintenance windows should be scheduled with >=72h notice; Redwood to provide per-route token-level billing & latency dashboards.

SLA negotiation points (customer): 99.95% regional uptime for Dedicated endpoints, explicit credit formula for capacity shortfalls, emergency burst carve-outs during incidents, and clearer definitions of "maintenance" vs "outage".
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18: "We need predictable tail latency under pressure — it's the difference between operator trusts app or shelving it."
Canary/rollout: want canary capacity + staged traffic migration. POC used 10% canary traffic with KV cache priming; customer asks for documented rollout SLOs and rollback triggers.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to 12–24 month reserved plan if latency/throughput guarantees and clear credits for missed SLOs are in contract.
Open technical asks: detailed tokenization accounting for telemetry payloads, model quantization guidance (FP16 vs 8-bit), and a kernel-selection summary for A100/H100 hosts.
Next trial: extend POC to include cross-region failover test (run for 48h with induced region outage) and measure SLA credit eligibility conditions.
